items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Somewhere along the line I played with Zootie but I think it would have been always in jam sessions, or special jazz programs around New York... Oh, yeah, he played. He played with me in my small band at Café Society for years.

ctx.x: because I came up with him in Chicago. He was the drummer in Chicago when I came up, and it was the Three Duces, he hired me in his band. And if you played with Zootie, that was a stamp of approval. If you got to play with Zootie --
Somewhere along the line I played with Zootie but I think it would have been always in jam sessions, or special jazz programs around New York. I don't believe in Chicago, maybe.
